description: Two sections of one form whose fields have the same accessible names. Likely when nothing tells them apart programmatically: titles in bold tied to nothing, headings (which are exposed as structure but do not tell the names apart: section 3E of the brief), and the two dates of a period. Nothing when each section is a fieldset with a legend, when each field is described by the title of its section, when the names differ, when the fields are in two forms, and when they are in the rows of a table.
